title: Tribunal Review Request
description: Template for requesting an advisory review from the T0 Passive Tribunal.

task_uuid.description: Unique identifier for the engineering task or milestone.

mutation_intent.description: A high-level summary of what this code change attempts to do.

risk_level.description: The self-assessed risk level of the change.

diff_summary.description: A truncated diff or unified diff summary of the proposed changes.

doctrine_context.description: Any active engineering constraints or rules (e.g., 'no external APIs').
